title: Lavonte David: Maybe I should have stayed to play with Rueben Bain

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Lavonte David: Maybe I should have stayed to play with Rueben Bain
sources.description: Lavonte David announced his retirement in March, but a move the Bucs made the next month gave their longtime linebacker cause to wonder if he should have stuck around for a 15th season.
